# The kernel properties that are deliberately EXTENSION POINTS: the kernel
# names the carrier and leaves it unconstrained, and a profile supplies the
# closed value set. FROZEN, and the freeze is the point.
#
# Two audits key off this list, from opposite directions:
#
#   * `LifecycleKindOwnershipTests.test_kernel_carriers_stay_open_on_kind`
#     proves each listed property really is open in every compiled KERNEL
#     carrier — an extension point that quietly acquired a kernel closure
#     would reject the profile values it exists to admit.
#   * `OverlaySupersetTests` allows an overlay to restate a kernel property
#     ONLY when it is on this list. Without the list the exemption keyed on the
#     kernel definition merely BEING `{"type": "string"}` right now, so a future
#     overlay could convert a genuine kernel closure into a profile-only one —
#     a real relaxation of the kernel contract — and pass in silence.
#
# Adding an extension point is therefore a deliberate edit here, reviewed as
# such, not a side effect of loosening a kernel definition somewhere else.
KERNEL_EXTENSION_POINT_PROPERTIES = ("rkaf:lifecycleEventKind",)

# The generic Assertion envelope (constraints/core/assertion.cue). Every one of
# these MUST reach RelationshipAssertion through CUE composition — the envelope
# has exactly one source — and must still arrive in every compiled target.
#
# Composition may DE-DUPLICATE; it must never LOOSEN. A derived shape is
# therefore allowed to restate an envelope field in order to NARROW it (see
# RELATIONSHIP_ASSERTION_NARROWINGS below); what it may not do is arrive at a
# weaker compiled artifact than the CUE source enforces.
#
# The list is grouped the way constraints/core/assertion.cue is: the first two
# entries arrive from `#ConsumerDisposition`, the mutable consumer-scoped half
# the envelope composes; the rest are the envelope's own. `#AssertionProposition`
# — subject, predicate, polarity — is NOT here, and that absence is the point of
# Core §2.3: proposition content is composed by the proposition-bearing forms,
# never by the envelope.
ASSERTION_ENVELOPE_FIELDS = (
    "rkaf:usageEligibility",
    "rkaf:consumerLifecycleState",
    "rkaf:hasAccessScope",
    "rkaf:assertionOrigin",
    "rkaf:epistemicBasis",
    "rkaf:hasApplicability",
    "rkaf:hasJustification",
    "rkaf:hasWarrant",
    "rkaf:hasAuthority",
    "rkaf:hasRetentionPolicy",
    "prov:wasDerivedFrom",
    "rkaf:hasSourceClaimant",
    "rkaf:hasExtractionProvenance",
    "rkaf:hasConfidence",
    "rkaf:supersedesAssertion",
    "rkaf:assertedAt",
)

# Immutable proposition content (constraints/core/assertion.cue,
# `#AssertionProposition`). Shared by RelationshipAssertion and ValueAssertion;
# the object slot is form-specific and therefore not listed.
ASSERTION_PROPOSITION_FIELDS = (
    "rkaf:assertsSubject",
    "rkaf:assertsPredicate",
    "rkaf:assertionPolarity",
)

# The mutable consumer-scoped disposition (`#ConsumerDisposition`). Core §2.3
# requires these to be structurally separate from the proposition core: an
# assertion's identity never includes them.
CONSUMER_DISPOSITION_FIELDS = (
    "rkaf:usageEligibility",
    "rkaf:consumerLifecycleState",
    "rkaf:hasAccessScope",
)

AI_TOUCHED_ORIGINS = (
    "rkaf:aiSuggested",
)

# The absolute-IRI lexical form RelationshipAssertion demands of its reference
# fields. The generic envelope types them as plain `string`.
IRI_PATTERN = r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[^\s]+$"

# Envelope properties RelationshipAssertion deliberately narrows to an IRI.
RELATIONSHIP_ASSERTION_NARROWED_PROPERTIES = (
    "rkaf:hasApplicability",
    "rkaf:hasJustification",
    "rkaf:hasWarrant",
    "rkaf:hasAuthority",
)

# The fifth narrowing: the envelope's AI-lineage conditionals require
# hasAILineage; RelationshipAssertion additionally requires it to be an IRI.
RELATIONSHIP_ASSERTION_NARROWED_CONDITIONAL = "rkaf:hasAILineage"

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: """
+        targetClass: rkaf:Example
+        message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+        ---
+        PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+        SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+        """
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
 
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: """
+        targetClass: rkaf:Example
+        message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+        ---
+        PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+        SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+        """
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
 
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)

+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

class AnalysisModuleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """The document-analysis module (spec/rkaf-analysis.md).

    Three things this module promises are ABSENCES, and an absence is exactly
    what review habit fails to keep:

      * the kernel does not depend on this module;
      * this module declares no legal-effect and no jurisdiction vocabulary;
        and
      * `rkaf:ClosureClaim` is disabled — no second status value, no
        class-ranged edge into it, no closure proof type, no omission finding
        kind, and no fixture that treats one as finding evidence.

    Each test below fails the build on the smallest edit that would undo one of
    those, so enabling closure or admitting a domain reading has to be a
    deliberate, reviewed contract change rather than a plausible-looking
    one-line addition.
    """

    KERNEL_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "constraints" / "core"
    ANALYSIS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "constraints" / "analysis"
    PROFILES_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "constraints" / "profiles"
    CONSTRAINTS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "constraints"
    FIXTURES_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "fixtures"
    SHIPPED_CONTEXT = REPO_ROOT / "context" / "rkaf-context.jsonld"
    RKAF_NS = "https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#"

    # Every analysis CUE file, parsed once. The module is small and the parse
    # is the same one the compiler runs, so a shape that stopped compiling
    # fails here before it fails anywhere subtler.
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.sources = sorted(cls.ANALYSIS_DIR.glob("*.cue"))
        assert cls.sources, "constraints/analysis/ has no CUE files"
        cls.documents = {path.name: parse_cue_file(path) for path in cls.sources}
        cls.schemas = {
            name: json.loads(target_json_schema(doc))
            for name, doc in cls.documents.items()
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _declared_terms(documents) -> set[str]:
        """Every `rkaf:` class, property, and enum value the docs DECLARE."""
        terms: set[str] = set()
        for doc in documents:
            for shape in doc.shapes:
                terms.add(f"rkaf:{shape.name}")
                terms.update(
                    prop.name for prop in shape.properties if prop.name.startswith("rkaf:")
                )
            for enum in doc.enums:
                terms.update(value for value in enum.values if value.startswith("rkaf:"))
        return terms

    def _definition_names(self, root: Path) -> set[str]:
        names: set[str] = set()
        for cue in sorted(root.rglob("*.cue")):
            for match in re.finditer(r"^#(\w+):", cue.read_text(), re.MULTILINE):
                names.add(match.group(1))
        return names

    #
    # The fixture scans below must recognise a class by its EXPANDED IRI, not by

+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)

+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",

+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)
+

# ── Analysis §4.3 — a proof is bound to the comparison that cites it ─────────
#
# `rkaf:proofComparisonContext` is REQUIRED on every `#ResolverProofRecord`,
# and §4.3 says why: "a proof that does not name its comparison can be replayed
# against a different one, which is how a stale pass gets reused". Requiring the
# property only makes the binding DECLARED. Nothing per-property can check that
# the named comparison is the one actually citing the proof, because that is a
# statement relating two nodes.
#
# Without this shape a producer could take a 2019 gate pass, cite it from a 2026
# comparison, and leave `rkaf:proofComparisonContext` pointing at the 2019
# context: every per-property constraint passes, and a stale pass backs a fresh
# discrepancy finding. `rkaf:proofRecordDigest` does not catch it either — the
# proof record is unedited; it is the CITATION that is fraudulent.
#
# Written to fire only when the proof node is present in the graph and names a
# comparison, so a comparison published alone, with its proofs dereferenced
# elsewhere, validates exactly as it did before.
rkaf:ResolverProofComparisonBindingShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
  sh:sparql [
    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
    sh:message "A rkaf:ResolverProofRecord cited by rkaf:comparisonProofRecord MUST name that same rkaf:RelationComparisonContext in rkaf:proofComparisonContext. A proof issued for another comparison is a replayed, possibly stale, pass (spec/rkaf-analysis.md §4.3)." ;
    sh:select """
      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
      SELECT $this
      WHERE {
        $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?proof .
        ?proof rkaf:proofComparisonContext ?other .
        FILTER (?other != $this)
      }
    """ ;
  ] .

# ── Analysis §4 extension — machine-adjudication proofs ARE resolver proofs ──
#
# A machine-adjudication proof (`constraints/analysis/machine-adjudication.cue`,
# `#MachineAdjudicationProof`) is NOT a second `@type`. It is a plain
# `rkaf:ResolverProofRecord` whose `rkaf:proofType` equals the literal
# `rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof`: two structs declaring the same `@type`
# literal would collide in `tools/conformance_lib.py::schema_bindings()`
# (exactly one compiled schema may validate a given `@type`), and an
# `rdfs:subClassOf`-related second `@type` does not help either — the SHACL
# `sh:class` constraint component does not apply RDFS subclass entailment the
# way `sh:targetClass` does without an explicitly supplied `ont_graph`, and
# `tools/ci_validate.py` never supplies one. So the two shapes below find a
# machine-adjudication proof by its `rkaf:proofType` value, never by `rdf:type`,
# and every cross-node rule that already reasons over `rkaf:ResolverProofRecord`
# — `sh:class` on `rkaf:comparisonProofRecord` / `rkaf:findingProofRecord`, and
# `rkaf:ResolverProofComparisonBindingShape` above — applies to it for free,
# because it always was one.

# ── Machine adjudication — at least one independent pair ─────────────────────
#
# Analysis §4 extension (machine-adjudication.cue) says a model MAY produce a
# machine-adjudication proof, but no model decides a comparison OUTCOME alone
# (spec/rkaf-analysis.md §3.4). What makes that true in the graph, not only in
# prose, is this rule: among the machine-adjudication proofs a claim cites — a
# `rkaf:RelationComparisonContext` via `rkaf:comparisonProofRecord`, or a
# `rkaf:RelationFinding` via `rkaf:findingProofRecord` — at least one PAIR must
# answer the identical sealed question (`rkaf:sealedRequestDigest` equal) while
# being genuinely independent witnesses of it: distinct on all five of
# `rkaf:proofIssuer` (validator actor), `rkaf:independenceGroup`,
# `rkaf:proofIssuer -> rkaf:proofResolver` (provider),
# `rkaf:hasAILineage -> rkaf:modelId` (provider model ID), and
# `rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact` (response artifact). A single
# machine-adjudication proof, or a set that collapses onto one axis, is one
# opinion wearing a proof record. The fifth axis (spec/rkaf-refspec.md,
# corrected 2026-08-09) keeps two "independent" machines from qualifying a
# pair by each sealing the same shared response: distinct issuers, groups,
# providers, and model IDs still describe one witnessed answer if that answer
# is the identical sealed artifact.
#
# `rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact` names the sealed RECORD of that proof's own
# run, not the response bytes it contains: artifact-IRI inequality is a
# producer promise, not a content check. A producer MUST mint a distinct
# per-run artifact for every adjudication call even when two genuinely
# independent runs return byte-identical output (run identity, not content
# identity) — the same way `rkaf:Artifact` may itself be content-addressed
# (`rkaf:cid`, `rkaf:hash-sha256`; spec/rkaf-core.md §4.1) without that making
# two separately-fetched copies of one document into two documents. Two
# proofs naming the SAME `rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact` are read as one
# response copied onto a second proof record, never as two independent
# witnesses that happened to agree byte-for-byte.
#
# This SPARQL enforces artifact-IRI distinctness, which is necessary but not
# sufficient on its own: `rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact` carries at most one
# value per proof (`compiled/shacl/analysis/resolver-proof-record.ttl`,
# generated from the `rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof` conditional in
# `constraints/analysis/resolver-proof-record.cue`) precisely so a proof
# cannot carry both a shared artifact and a distinct decoy one and pass this
# rule on the decoy.
#
# This corrects rulespec's own prior wording (spec/rkaf-analysis.md §4
# extension, corrected 2026-08-09): the requirement is AT LEAST ONE independent
# pair, not EXACTLY
# TWO proofs. The stricter "exactly two" rule was wrong on its own terms: it
# would reject a valid three-machine corroboration, discarding a third witness
# that helped establish the relation, which is the opposite of what an
# independence requirement is for. The companion
# `rkaf:MachineAdjudicationCompleteSupportShape` below is the other half of
# that correction — this shape proves independence exists; that one proves
# nothing corroborating was thrown away to manufacture it.
#
# Fires only when at least one cited proof's `rkaf:proofType` is
# `rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof`, so a claim resting on other resolver
# protocols entirely is untouched.
rkaf:MachineAdjudicationIndependentPairShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationFinding ;
  sh:sparql [
    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
    sh:message "A claim citing any rkaf:ResolverProofRecord whose rkaf:proofType is rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof MUST cite at least one PAIR of them that share rkaf:sealedRequestDigest and are distinct on all five independence axes: rkaf:proofIssuer (validator actor), rkaf:independenceGroup, rkaf:proofIssuer/rkaf:proofResolver (provider), rkaf:hasAILineage/rkaf:modelId (provider model ID), and rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact (response artifact). A single machine adjudication, or a set that collapses onto one axis, is one opinion, not independent corroboration (spec/rkaf-analysis.md §3.4, §4 extension; spec/rkaf-refspec.md, corrected 2026-08-09)." ;
    sh:select """
      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
      SELECT DISTINCT $this
      WHERE {
        {
          { $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?proof }
          UNION
          { $this rkaf:findingProofRecord ?proof }
        }
        ?proof rkaf:proofType rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof .
        FILTER NOT EXISTS {
          {
            { $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?p1 }
            UNION
            { $this rkaf:findingProofRecord ?p1 }
          }
          {
            { $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?p2 }
            UNION
            { $this rkaf:findingProofRecord ?p2 }
          }
          ?p1 rkaf:proofType rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof .
          ?p2 rkaf:proofType rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof .
          FILTER (?p1 != ?p2)
          ?p1 rkaf:sealedRequestDigest ?digest .
          ?p2 rkaf:sealedRequestDigest ?digest .
          ?p1 rkaf:proofIssuer ?actor1 .
          ?p2 rkaf:proofIssuer ?actor2 .
          FILTER (?actor1 != ?actor2)
          ?p1 rkaf:independenceGroup ?group1 .
          ?p2 rkaf:independenceGroup ?group2 .
          FILTER (?group1 != ?group2)
          ?actor1 rkaf:proofResolver ?provider1 .
          ?actor2 rkaf:proofResolver ?provider2 .
          FILTER (?provider1 != ?provider2)
          ?p1 rkaf:hasAILineage ?lineage1 .
          ?p2 rkaf:hasAILineage ?lineage2 .
          ?lineage1 rkaf:modelId ?model1 .
          ?lineage2 rkaf:modelId ?model2 .
          FILTER (?model1 != ?model2)
          ?p1 rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?artifact1 .
          ?p2 rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?artifact2 .
          FILTER (?artifact1 != ?artifact2)
        }
      }
    """ ;
  ] .

# ── Machine adjudication — complete support retained ──────────────────────────
#
# The companion half of the independence rule above. A claim MUST cite the
# complete set of machine-adjudication proofs that supported it, once
# qualification runs: publishing only the first independent pair and quietly
# dropping a third, fourth, or later machine that answered the SAME sealed
# question discards evidence that helped determine the relation, even though
# independence alone would already be satisfied by the pair kept
# (spec/rkaf-analysis.md §4 extension, corrected 2026-08-09).
#
# Per-property SHACL cannot reach this: nothing about ONE cited proof record is
# wrong, and the defect is a proof that self-declares support for this claim
# (`rkaf:proofComparisonContext` naming `$this`, exactly the declared half of
# `rkaf:ResolverProofComparisonBindingShape`) yet is absent from the citing
# list. `rkaf:proofRecordDigest` cannot catch it either — the discarded proof
# is untouched; it is the claim's citation list that is incomplete.
#
# Scoped to `rkaf:RelationComparisonContext` only: a machine-adjudication proof
# declares the comparison it was issued for via `rkaf:proofComparisonContext`,
# and no analogous self-declaring edge exists from a proof back to a
# `rkaf:RelationFinding`, so there is nothing for this direction of the rule to
# read on that class.
rkaf:MachineAdjudicationCompleteSupportShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
  sh:sparql [
    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
    sh:message "A rkaf:ResolverProofRecord whose rkaf:proofType is rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof, that declares rkaf:proofComparisonContext naming this comparison and shares rkaf:sealedRequestDigest with a proof this comparison DOES cite, MUST also be cited by rkaf:comparisonProofRecord. Discarding a corroborating machine-adjudication proof loses evidence (spec/rkaf-analysis.md §4 extension)." ;
    sh:select """
      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
      SELECT DISTINCT $this
      WHERE {
        $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?cited .
        ?cited rkaf:proofType rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof ;
               rkaf:sealedRequestDigest ?digest .
        ?discarded rkaf:proofType rkaf:machineAdjudicationProof ;
                   rkaf:proofComparisonContext $this ;
                   rkaf:sealedRequestDigest ?digest .
        FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?discarded }
      }
    """ ;
  ] .

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)
+

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+class ShaclSparqlCompilerTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    SOURCES = (
+        REPO_ROOT / "constraints/analysis/machine-adjudication.cue",
+        REPO_ROOT / "constraints/analysis/resolver-proof-record.cue",
+    )
+
+    def test_four_relational_rules_are_emitted_as_parseable_shacl(self) -> None:
+        graph = Graph()
+        observed: set[URIRef] = set()
+        for source in self.SOURCES:
+            document = parse_cue_file(source)
+            turtle = target_shacl_sparql(document)
+            self.assertNotIn("sh:sparql", target_shacl(document))
+            graph.parse(data=turtle, format="turtle")
+            observed.update(
+                subject
+                for subject in graph.subjects(RDF.type, SH.NodeShape)
+                if str(subject).startswith("https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#")
+            )
+        expected = {
+            URIRef("https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#" + local)
+            for local in (
+                "MachineAdjudicationFiveAxisIndependenceShape",
+                "MachineAdjudicationCompleteSupportShape",
+                "MachineAdjudicationVerdictLatticeFoldShape",
+                "MachineAdjudicationProofReplayShape",
+            )
+        }
+        self.assertEqual(expected, observed)
+

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "

+                "  ] .",

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+
