@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _prove_shape_graph_conforms(ontology_digest: str, shapes_digest: str) -> None:
    """Prove the shape graph is well-formed SHACL and the ontology conforms to it.

    This asks a question about two immutable binding files -- `atlas.ttl` and
    `atlas.shacl.ttl` -- and nothing else. It is a property of the binding, not
    of any distribution being validated, so it is derived once per process
    instead of once per distribution.

    That distinction is not a micro-optimization. Measured on this binding, the
    meta-conformance derivation costs ~1.880s while the data conformance it
    used to accompany costs ~0.070s, so validating the 110-case corpus spent
    roughly 170s of its ~204s re-deriving one unchanging fact 110 times.

    Nothing is trusted that was not proven. The cache key is the pair of file
    digests, recomputed from disk by the caller on every call, so editing
    either file re-derives instead of reusing the proof. `_fail` raises, and
    `lru_cache` never stores a result for a call that raised, so a shape graph
    that does not conform is re-derived and re-refused every single time --
    the failure can never be cached as a pass.
    """

    ontology, shapes = _parse_binding_graphs()
    ontology_view = inoculate(Graph(), ontology)
    try:
        meta_view = _ShaclDataView([Graph(), ontology_view])
        meta_conforms, _, meta_report = shacl_validate(
            meta_view,
            shacl_graph=shapes,
            inference="none",
            inplace=True,
            advanced=False,
            abort_on_first=False,
            allow_infos=False,
            allow_warnings=False,
            meta_shacl=True,
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - normalize SHACL processor failures
        _fail("shacl.meta", f"SHACL processor failed for asserted: {exc}")
    if not meta_conforms:
        compact = " ".join(str(meta_report).split())
        _fail("shacl.meta", f"shape graph does not conform: {compact[:900]}")


def _run_shacl(graphs: Mapping[str, Graph], ontology: Graph, shapes: Graph) -> None:
    """Validate authoritative inputs; exact regeneration validates the projection.

    Red builds fail fast. Measured on a 32M-quad non-conforming distribution
    (2026-08-11, `plans/validation-cost-reset-plan.md`), the batched fast path
    detected the miss in minutes and the whole-graph normative run then took
    **94 minutes solely to phrase the failure report** -- 78% of a two-hour
    run, on the path a developer iterates on. So the default red path
    re-validates only the focus nodes the fast path already named, under the
    unmodified normative shapes over the unmodified data graph
    (`_focused_shacl_report`): the same engine, the same constraint
    components, seconds instead of hours.

    `REFSPEC_ATLAS_VALIDATION_MODE=audit` restores the whole-graph normative
    run -- read once, here, so one distribution is never validated half in
    each mode. Anything else, including unset, fails fast. The failure code is
    `shacl.data` and the message names every violated constraint component in
    both modes; the focused path only narrows which nodes the engine is asked
    about, and falls back to the whole-graph report whenever the sample cannot
    be trusted to reproduce the same components.
    """

    _prove_shape_graph_conforms(file_sha256(ONTOLOGY_PATH), file_sha256(SHAPES_PATH))

    audit = os.environ.get(VALIDATION_MODE_ENV) == AUDIT_VALIDATION_MODE
    ontology_view = inoculate(Graph(), ontology)
    plan = _batched_shacl_plan(shapes)
    for role in ("asserted", "derived"):
        validation_view = _ShaclDataView([graphs[role], ontology_view])
        for prefix, namespace in ontology.namespaces():
            validation_view.namespace_manager.bind(prefix, namespace)

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)
+

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+        "",

+        "",

+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+def _check_rulespec_shapes_lock() -> None:
+    """Verify the local compiler output against its package-provenance pin."""
+
+    lock = _load_json(RULESPEC_SHAPES_LOCK_PATH, require_canonical=True)

+        "formatVersion",
+        "output",

+        or lock["package"] != "rulespec-conformance"
+        or not isinstance(lock["packageVersion"], str)

+    output = lock["output"]
+    payload = RULESPEC_SHAPES_PATH.read_bytes()

+        "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+    }:

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)
+

+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.
