+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

 # recognizes the nested struct by that member rather than by a marker name.

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------
+
+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+
+    lock = _load_json(RULESPEC_SHAPES_LOCK_PATH, require_canonical=True)

+        "formatVersion",
+        "output",

+    output = lock["output"]
+    payload = RULESPEC_SHAPES_PATH.read_bytes()

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+def _check_rulespec_shapes_lock() -> None:
+    """Verify the local compiler output against its package-provenance pin."""
+
+    lock = _load_json(RULESPEC_SHAPES_LOCK_PATH, require_canonical=True)
+    if not isinstance(lock, Mapping) or set(lock) != {
+        "format",
+        "formatVersion",
+        "output",
+        "package",
+        "packageVersion",
+        "resources",
+    }:
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape lock is malformed")
+    if (
+        lock["format"] != "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock"
+        or lock["formatVersion"] != "1.0"
+        or lock["package"] != "rulespec-conformance"
+        or not isinstance(lock["packageVersion"], str)
+        or not lock["packageVersion"]
+    ):
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape lock identity differs")
+    output = lock["output"]
+    payload = RULESPEC_SHAPES_PATH.read_bytes()
+    if output != {
+        "byteLength": len(payload),
+        "digest": "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
+        "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+    }:
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape output differs from its lock")
+    resources = lock["resources"]
+    if (

+            for row in resources

+    ):

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")

+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+def _check_rulespec_shapes_lock() -> None:
+    """Verify the local compiler output against its package-provenance pin."""
+
+    lock = _load_json(RULESPEC_SHAPES_LOCK_PATH, require_canonical=True)
+    if not isinstance(lock, Mapping) or set(lock) != {
+        "format",
+        "formatVersion",
+        "output",
+        "package",
+        "packageVersion",
+        "resources",
+    }:
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape lock is malformed")
+    if (
+        lock["format"] != "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock"
+        or lock["formatVersion"] != "1.0"
+        or lock["package"] != "rulespec-conformance"
+        or not isinstance(lock["packageVersion"], str)
+        or not lock["packageVersion"]
+    ):
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape lock identity differs")
+    output = lock["output"]
+    payload = RULESPEC_SHAPES_PATH.read_bytes()
+    if output != {
+        "byteLength": len(payload),
+        "digest": "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
+        "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+    }:
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape output differs from its lock")
+    resources = lock["resources"]
+    if (
+        not isinstance(resources, list)
+        or [row.get("name") for row in resources if isinstance(row, Mapping)]
+        != ["machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record"]
+        or any(
+            not isinstance(row, Mapping)
+            or set(row) != {"accessor", "byteLength", "digest", "name"}
+            or not isinstance(row["byteLength"], int)
+            or row["byteLength"] <= 0
+            or not isinstance(row["digest"], str)
+            or not DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(row["digest"])
+            for row in resources
+        )
+    ):
+        _fail("binding.rulespec-shapes", "RuleSpec shape resource pins are malformed")

+// Relational constraints stay in this CUE source but remain SPARQL because
+// they join several records. tools/constraints_compile.py validates the
+// annotation header and emits the SHACL node/constraint scaffolding. The
+// query is the only authored part of the generated shape.
+#MachineAdjudicationFiveAxisIndependenceShapeSparql: """
+targetClass: rkaf:RelationComparisonContext
+message: A satisfied comparison must cite a proof pair that differs by actor, independence group, provider, model ID, and response artifact.
+---
+PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+SELECT $this
+WHERE {
+  $this rkaf:comparisonOutcome rkaf:comparisonSatisfied .
+  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
+    $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?leftProof, ?rightProof .
+    FILTER(?leftProof != ?rightProof)
+
+    ?leftProof
+      rkaf:proofIssuer ?leftIssuer ;
+      rkaf:independenceGroup ?leftGroup ;
+      rkaf:hasAILineage ?leftLineage ;
+      rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?leftResponse .
+    ?rightProof
+      rkaf:proofIssuer ?rightIssuer ;
+      rkaf:independenceGroup ?rightGroup ;
+      rkaf:hasAILineage ?rightLineage ;
+      rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?rightResponse .
+    ?leftIssuer rkaf:proofResolver ?leftProvider .
+    ?rightIssuer rkaf:proofResolver ?rightProvider .
+    ?leftLineage rkaf:modelId ?leftModel .
+    ?rightLineage rkaf:modelId ?rightModel .
+
+    FILTER(
+      ?leftIssuer != ?rightIssuer &&
+      ?leftGroup != ?rightGroup &&
+      ?leftProvider != ?rightProvider &&
+      STR(?leftModel) != STR(?rightModel) &&
+      ?leftResponse != ?rightResponse
+    )
+  }
+}
+"""

+---
+PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

+

+  $this

+    rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?proof .

+          ?nearProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict rkaf:verdictNearSame .

+          $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badCloseProof .
+          ?badCloseProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badCloseVerdict .
+          FILTER(?badCloseVerdict NOT IN (
+            rkaf:verdictSame,
+            rkaf:verdictNearSame

+        }
+      ) ||

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+

+# ---- SHACL-SPARQL target (annotated relational rules) --------------------

+def target_shacl_sparql(doc: ConstraintDoc) -> str:
+    """Emit only the relational rules explicitly carried by this CUE file."""
+
+    out: list[str] = [
+        "# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/constraints_compile.py "
+        "(target=shacl-sparql).",
+        "# Source: " + (
+            _source_relpath(doc.source_file) or str(doc.source_file or "unknown")
+        ),
+        "# DO NOT EDIT: change the #*ShapeSparql annotation in the CUE source.",
+        "",
+        "@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .",
+        "@prefix rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for constraint in doc.sparql_constraints:
+        out.append(f"rkaf:{constraint.shape_name} a sh:NodeShape ;")
+        for target_class in constraint.target_classes:
+            out.append(f"  sh:targetClass {target_class} ;")
+        out.extend(
+            (
+                "  sh:sparql [",
+                "    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;",
+                f"    sh:message {json.dumps(constraint.message)} ;",
+                '    sh:select """',
+                constraint.select,
+                '    """ ;',
+                "  ] .",
+                "",
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(out)

+"""Refresh the RuleSpec-owned adjudication shapes vendored into this binding.
+
+The binding validator deliberately imports no RefSpec or RuleSpec package
+code. This development-time generator is the only package-aware side of that
+boundary: it reads compiler output through the installed
+``rulespec_conformance.contract.resources`` accessor, writes plain Turtle
+beside the Atlas shapes, and records exact source and output digests.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rulespec_conformance.contract import VERSION, resources
+
+BINDING_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+LOCK_PATH = BINDING_ROOT / "shapes" / "rulespec-adjudication.lock.json"
+RESOURCE_NAMES = ("machine-adjudication", "resolver-proof-record")
+
+
+def _digest(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def render() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+    parts = [
+        "# GENERATED by tools/refresh_rulespec_adjudication_shapes.py.",
+        "# Source: rulespec-conformance compiler output; do not edit here.",
+        f"# Rulespec contract version: {VERSION}",
+        "",
+    ]
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for name in RESOURCE_NAMES:
+        text = resources.shacl_sparql(name, family="analysis")
+        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
+        source_rows.append(
+            {
+                "accessor": (
+                    "rulespec_conformance.contract.resources."
+                    f"shacl_sparql({name!r}, family='analysis')"
+                ),
+                "byteLength": len(payload),
+                "digest": _digest(payload),
+                "name": name,
+            }
+        )
+        parts.extend((text.rstrip(), ""))
+    output = "\n".join(parts).encode("utf-8")
+    lock = _canonical_json(
+        {
+            "format": "RulespecAdjudicationShapeLock",
+            "formatVersion": "1.0",
+            "output": {
+                "byteLength": len(output),
+                "digest": _digest(output),
+                "path": "shapes/rulespec-adjudication.shacl.ttl",
+            },
+            "package": "rulespec-conformance",
+            "packageVersion": VERSION,
+            "resources": source_rows,
+        }
+    )
+    return output, lock
+
+
+def _check(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} is missing")
+        return False
+    observed = path.read_bytes()
+    if observed != expected:
+        print(
+            f"STALE: {path.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} differs "
+            f"(expected {_digest(expected)}, found {_digest(observed)})"
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="refuse stale generated data instead of refreshing it",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output, lock = render()
+    if args.check:
+        return 0 if _check(OUTPUT_PATH, output) and _check(LOCK_PATH, lock) else 1
+    OUTPUT_PATH.write_bytes(output)
+    LOCK_PATH.write_bytes(lock)
+    print(
+        "refreshed "
+        f"{OUTPUT_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)} ({_digest(output)}) and "
+        f"{LOCK_PATH.relative_to(BINDING_ROOT)}"
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?ms)^#(?P<shape>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*Shape)Sparql:\s*"""\n'
+    r'(?P<body>.*?)\n"""\s*$'
+)
+COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\s]+|<[^\s<>]+>)$"
+)
+
+
+def parse_shacl_sparql_annotations(source: str) -> list[SparqlConstraintDef]:
+    """Parse the fail-closed CUE annotation format for graph rules.
+
+    The definition name supplies the stable shape local name. Its multiline
+    string has a generated-scaffolding header, a literal ``---`` separator,
+    then the SPARQL SELECT query::
+
+        #ExampleShapeSparql: <CUE multiline string>
+          targetClass: rkaf:Example
+          message: Explanation shown in a SHACL result.
+          ---
+          PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+          SELECT $this WHERE { ... }
+
+    Repeating ``targetClass`` is allowed. Everything else is rejected rather
+    than silently omitted from the emitted constraint.
+    """
+
+    constraints: list[SparqlConstraintDef] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for match in SHACL_SPARQL_BLOCK_RE.finditer(source):
+        shape_name = match.group("shape")
+        if shape_name in seen:
+            raise CompileError(f"duplicate SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name}")
+        seen.add(shape_name)
+        header, separator, select = match.group("body").partition("\n---\n")
+        if not separator:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no --- query separator"
+            )
+        targets: list[str] = []
+        message: Optional[str] = None
+        for raw_line in header.splitlines():
+            line = raw_line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            key, colon, value = line.partition(":")
+            if not colon or not value.strip():
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has malformed header {line!r}"
+                )
+            value = value.strip()
+            if key == "targetClass":
+                if not COMPACT_OR_ABSOLUTE_IRI_RE.fullmatch(value):
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has invalid targetClass {value!r}"
+                    )
+                targets.append(value)
+            elif key == "message":
+                if message is not None:
+                    raise CompileError(
+                        f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} repeats message"
+                    )
+                message = value
+            else:
+                raise CompileError(
+                    f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has unknown header {key!r}"
+                )
+        query = select.strip()
+        if not targets:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no targetClass"
+            )
+        if not message:
+            raise CompileError(f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} has no message")
+        if not re.search(r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+(?:DISTINCT\s+)?\$this\b", query):
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} must SELECT $this"
+            )
+        if '"""' in query:
+            raise CompileError(
+                f"SHACL-SPARQL shape {shape_name} contains a Turtle long-string terminator"
+            )
+        constraints.append(
+            SparqlConstraintDef(
+                shape_name=shape_name,
+                target_classes=targets,
+                message=message,
+                select=query,
+            )
+        )
+    return constraints
+
